Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class VisionOutput

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.VisionOutput
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable, edu.wpi.first.util.WPISerializable
public class VisionOutput extends Object implements edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable
A single pose estimate and its supporting AprilTag detections, produced by one call to VisionCameraIO.update(). This is the common data type all camera IO implementations (LimelightVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionSimCameraIO) report through, and what Vision consumes and republishes to NetworkTables.

Implements StructSerializable via the nested VisionOutput.VisionOutputStruct so instances can be logged/published directly.
